data.narrative:
Union, a Seed-stage Defense & Security company founded by Will Somerindyke, Jon Reiland, and Joe Musselman, has raised $51.3M to date. The valuation assessment draws from a comparables universe of ten companies spanning the sector: two public entities (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and eight private firms including UFORCE, Anduril Industries, Helsing, Castelion, and Shield AI, representing similar risk and stage profiles.

Two valuation methods yield triangulated results. Stage-progression analysis, applying a standard 2.5x step-up multiplier from Seed to next stage against the $51.3M raised proxy, implies $128M. Peer-median analysis across three same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables—UFORCE ($1.0B at Seed), Singularity ($400M at Series A), and NODA AI ($125M at Series A)—yields a $400M median valuation with a range spanning $125M to $1.0B.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $109M (low) to $460M (high), with a median of $264M. This wide dispersion reflects material uncertainty inherent in early-stage Defense & Security valuations: peer comps show substantial heterogeneity ($125M–$1.0B), and stage-progression methodology assumes standardized scaling that may not hold given the sector's capital intensity and customer concentration. Key variables affecting ultimate valuation include customer pipeline depth, technology differentiation relative to named competitors, and path to Series A fundraising.
